notes.title: Astra: EOA 1.2
notes.content:
[b]Hello welcome to Astra: EOA 1.2![/b]

You might be wondering where 1.1 is and it technically shipped as an update launch day to help fix a rare but major bug, in my haste I didn't properly index it. Either way!

[b]Astra: EOA 1.1:[/b]

- Added collision detection underneath all maps so if the player fell out the current scene attempts to restart or load the most recent save. 

[b]Astra: EOA 1.2:[/b]

- Added indicator at the beginning of the game to specify the player has picked up wand and dagger, this is to help make it more clear as to what weapons you have so you don't try to enchant the dagger.

- Adjusted decals in “easter egg house” to prevent flickering from a distance.

- Adjusted Duke Ashlargs health to make him essentially immortal, (his health pool is massive but someone found a way to kill him without dying first) 

- Adjusted loading and exiting from certain interiors to prevent rare bug where wrong interior loads. 

Saves should be all fine, no need to reset.

Thanks for all the support please reach out if I broke anything!

notes.title: Astra: Era Of Anguish OUT NOW
notes.content:
Astra: EOA is out now! I hope you all enjoy the lots of work that have gone into this project it is tough developing open-world games but I would like to thank all of you guys for making it enjoyable and worth it. Astra: EOA marks the end of the Gor3 trilogy and the Gor3 franchise in terms of my involvement. 

When I made the first Gor3 game I had never made a game before and knew nothing about coding or how to ship a game. It has been such a joy to work on these games and learn game creation and  I can't thank those who helped me with the creation of these games enough.

Excited to keep making!

Please enjoy!

notes.title: ASTRA: EOA Demo Update
notes.content:
[b]The Astra: EOA Demo has a new update.[/b]

[b]Patchnotes:[/b]

[u]Fixes:[/u]
-Fixed bug where the player could duplicate some interactable items.
-Fixed bug where the player could randomly teleport to the wrong interior.
-Fixed sound bug where the player could spam the interact key to enter a building.

[u]Additions:[/u]
-Switched engine version from 6.6 -> 6.7 this shouldn't cause any major issues and might improve FPS.
